scenes.text:
LEVEL 1 — GROCERY STORE
Ten queues stand between you and the end of your day. First stop: the grocery store. Fluorescent lights hum overhead. You stand behind four shoppers with full carts. A cashier calls for a price check.

queue.finishLabel: Check out — you reached the front!

scenes.text: Groceries bagged. You survived the first queue.

LEVEL 2 — BUS STATION
Five people stand at the curb. A bus idles with its doors closed. The driver is on a break.

queue.finishLabel: Board the bus — you're at the front!

scenes.text: You climb aboard and find a seat. The bus lurches forward.

LEVEL 3 — TRAIN STATION
Six travelers wait at the ticket window. A departure board flickers. Someone asks about track 4.

queue.finishLabel: Buy your ticket — you made it to the window!

scenes.text: Ticket in hand. The platform awaits.

LEVEL 4 — FARMERS MARKET
Five customers crowd a produce stand. Someone is haggling over heirloom tomatoes. The smell of fresh bread is incredible.
Bag of vegetables acquired. The airport is next.

LEVEL 5 — AIRPORT
Eight people snake through the security queue. Shoes come off. Laptops come out. A toddler wails.

queue.finishLabel: Clear security — you reached the front!

scenes.text: Belt repacked. Shoes re-laced. You survived airport security.

LEVEL 6 — MUSEUM
Four tourists block the ticket counter. A guide speaks in a whisper that somehow carries. Someone takes a flash photo.

queue.finishLabel: Get your ticket — you're at the counter!

scenes.text: Ticket stub in hand. The city calls you back to the rails.

choices.label: Rush to the busy train station (Level 7)

scenes.text:
LEVEL 7 — BUSY TRAIN STATION
Ten people cram the platform queue. Trains scream past. A PA system crackles nonsense. Everyone looks late.

queue.finishLabel: Board your train — you made it to the front!

scenes.text: You squeeze through the doors as they close. Next stop: the doctor.

LEVEL 8 — DOCTOR'S OFFICE
Seven patients sit in plastic chairs. A TV plays daytime talk shows. The receptionist says "the doctor is running behind."

queue.finishLabel: See the doctor — your name was called!

scenes.text: Checkup done. One more flight and then the final gauntlet.

LEVEL 9 — FLIGHT CHECK-IN
Nine travelers crowd the counter. Suitcases get weighed. Someone's bag is overweight. The clock ticks.

queue.finishLabel: Get your boarding pass — you're at the counter!

scenes.text: Boarding pass printed. One queue remains — the worst one.

LEVEL 10 — PENN STATION, NYC
Havoc. Twelve people become forty. Announcements war with buskers. You can't tell which line is which. A rat judges you from the tracks.

queue.finishLabel: Reach the ticket agent — you survived Penn Station!

scenes.text: You did it. Ten queues. One individual. Zero remaining patience — but you made it. You collapse onto your train home, a legend of waiting.
The queue wins again. Whether your patience or your composure gave out first, you abandon the line and head home defeated.
